purpose: Verify that valid student coordinator and co-coordinator assignments are accepted.
preconditions: The selected student records exist in the shared student registry.
action_or_input: Create or update a club with one valid coordinator and one valid co-coordinator.
expected_result: The leadership assignments are accepted and retained.

purpose: Verify that invalid initial or replacement leadership assignments are rejected.
preconditions: The selected coordinator, co-coordinator, or replacement leader does not correspond to a valid student.
action_or_input: Attempt club creation or leadership change using the invalid student selection.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped, and no invalid leadership assignment is retained.

purpose: Verify that a valid faculty member can be assigned and used as Club Faculty Councillor.
preconditions: The selected faculty record exists and is valid.
action_or_input: Assign the faculty member to a club during creation or event context setup.
expected_result: The faculty councillor assignment is accepted.

purpose: Verify that an invalid faculty councillor is rejected.
preconditions: The selected faculty member is not a valid faculty record.
action_or_input: Assign or use the invalid faculty member as Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped, and no invalid councillor assignment is retained.

purpose: Verify that all explicitly allowed club categories are accepted.
preconditions: A Student Admin is creating a club.
action_or_input: Create separate club categories using Technical, Sports, and Cultural.
expected_result: Each of the three category values is accepted.

purpose: Verify that categories outside the allowed set are rejected.
preconditions: A Student Admin is creating a club.
action_or_input: Submit a club category not equal to Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
expected_result: The club category is rejected and the club is not created with that category.

purpose: Verify that Student Admin club creation starts in the open state.
preconditions: A Student Admin is authenticated; leadership and faculty assignments are valid.
action_or_input: Create a club with an allowed category and valid assignments.
expected_result: A new club is created in the open state.

purpose: Verify that successful Student Admin approval confirms an open club.
preconditions: An open club exists.
action_or_input: Have Student Admin approve the open club.
expected_result: The club state changes from open to confirmed.

purpose: Verify that a booking with start earlier than end is accepted.
preconditions: The venue is configured and no conflicting booking exists.
action_or_input: Submit a session or event whose start time is earlier than its end time.
expected_result: The booking time range is accepted.

purpose: Verify that equal or reversed booking times are rejected.
preconditions: A session or event booking is being submitted.
action_or_input: Submit separate cases where start equals end, and where start is later than end.
expected_result: Both invalid ranges are rejected and no booking is created.

purpose: Verify rejection of overlapping sessions in the same venue and on the same date.
preconditions: A configured venue has an existing session on a date.
action_or_input: Submit another session in the same venue and on the same date with overlapping time.
expected_result: The session booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify rejection of overlapping events in the same venue and on the same date.
preconditions: A configured venue has an existing event on a date.
action_or_input: Submit another event in the same venue and on the same date with overlapping time.
expected_result: The event booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify rejection of a cross-type overlap in the same venue and on the same date.
preconditions: A configured venue has an existing session or event on a date.
action_or_input: Submit an event against an existing session, or a session against an existing event, with overlapping time.
expected_result: The new booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify that a non-overlapping booking in the same venue is not rejected solely for existing activity.
preconditions: A configured venue has existing session or event activity.
action_or_input: Submit another session or event that does not overlap the existing time window.
expected_result: The non-overlapping booking is accepted.

purpose: Verify that membership application is permitted for a confirmed club.
preconditions: The student is authenticated and the selected club is confirmed.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to the confirmed club.
expected_result: The membership application is accepted as an open pending application.

purpose: Verify that membership application is denied for an open but unconfirmed club.
preconditions: The student is authenticated and the selected club is open but not confirmed.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a membership application to the open club.
expected_result: The membership application is rejected.

purpose: Verify that applications to multiple different confirmed clubs remain allowed.
preconditions: Two distinct clubs are confirmed; the student has no duplicate application for either club.
action_or_input: Submit one membership application to the first club and another to the second club.
expected_result: Both applications are allowed.

purpose: Verify that a duplicate application to the same club is rejected without changing membership state.
preconditions: The student already has an open or confirmed membership application for the confirmed club.
action_or_input: Submit another membership application to the same club.
expected_result: The duplicate is rejected and the existing application and membership state remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify that the applicable coordinator or co-coordinator may perform Club Head operations.
preconditions: The authenticated user is the coordinator or co-coordinator of the target club.
action_or_input: Invoke a Club Head operation for that club.
expected_result: The operation is authorized.

purpose: Verify that a coordinator or co-coordinator of another club or a non-Club-Head user cannot perform the operation.
preconditions: The authenticated user is not the coordinator or co-coordinator of the target club.
action_or_input: Attempt to invoke a Club Head operation for the target club.
expected_result: The operation is denied.

purpose: Verify successful membership approval changes state to confirmed and retains optional remarks.
preconditions: A pending open membership application exists and the applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Approve the open application with optional remarks.
expected_result: The application changes from open to confirmed and the remarks are retained if supplied.

purpose: Verify the minimum choice boundary for poll creation.
preconditions: A Club Head is creating a poll.
action_or_input: Create separate polls with one choice and with two choices.
expected_result: The one-choice poll is rejected; the two-choice poll is created.

purpose: Verify that notification and access are limited to the selected batch and branch groups.
preconditions: A Club Head has selected specific batch and branch target groups.
action_or_input: Create the poll and check the resulting notification recipient and poll-access audience.
expected_result: Only students belonging to the selected batch and branch groups are treated as the intended audience.

purpose: Verify that an active, unexpired poll allows an eligible target student to participate.
preconditions: The poll is active, unexpired, and its selected audience includes the student.
action_or_input: Open poll details and submit a vote.
expected_result: The poll details and vote submission are allowed.

purpose: Verify that participation is denied for an inactive poll.
preconditions: The student belongs to the selected audience, but the poll is inactive.
action_or_input: Request poll details or attempt to submit a vote.
expected_result: Poll participation is denied.

purpose: Verify that participation is denied for an expired poll.
preconditions: The student belongs to the selected audience, but the poll is expired.
action_or_input: Request poll details or attempt to submit a vote.
expected_result: Poll participation is denied.

purpose: Verify that participation is denied for a student outside the selected target audience.
preconditions: The poll is active and unexpired, but the student is outside its selected batch or branch groups.
action_or_input: Request poll details or attempt to submit a vote.
expected_result: Poll participation is denied.

purpose: Verify that a student may cast one vote in a poll.
preconditions: The student is eligible and has not previously voted in the poll.
action_or_input: Submit one vote for a poll choice.
expected_result: The first vote is accepted.

purpose: Verify that a second vote by the same student in the same poll is rejected.
preconditions: The student has already cast one vote in the poll.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit another vote in the same poll.
expected_result: The second vote is rejected and no additional vote is recorded.

purpose: Verify that leadership change records new current leaders and retires superseded active designations.
preconditions: A club has current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments; valid replacement student records exist.
action_or_input: Successfully change one or both active leadership assignments.
expected_result: The valid replacements become the current leaders and the superseded active designations no longer remain current.

purpose: Verify that a zero budget amount is permitted.
preconditions: A Club Head is submitting a club budget request and the required supporting file is present.
action_or_input: Submit a club budget request with amount equal to zero.
expected_result: The budget request is accepted.

purpose: Verify that negative budget amounts are rejected.
preconditions: A Club Head is submitting a club budget request.
action_or_input: Submit a club budget request with a negative amount.
expected_result: The budget request is rejected.

purpose: Verify that a budget request with the required supporting file is accepted.
preconditions: The budget amount is non-negative.
action_or_input: Submit the club budget request with the required supporting file.
expected_result: The budget request is accepted and stored with its supporting file.

purpose: Verify that a budget request is rejected when the required supporting file is missing.
preconditions: A Club Head is submitting a club budget request.
action_or_input: Submit the budget request without the required supporting file.
expected_result: The budget request is rejected.

purpose: Verify that an event report containing the required report or details file is accepted.
preconditions: A Club Head is submitting a report for a club event.
action_or_input: Submit the event report with the required report/details file.
expected_result: The event report is accepted and stored centrally.

purpose: Verify that an event report is rejected when the required file is missing.
preconditions: A Club Head is submitting an event report.
action_or_input: Submit the event report without the required report/details file.
expected_result: The event report submission is rejected.

purpose: Verify that a configured Gymkhana venue is accepted for booking.
preconditions: The venue exists in the configured Gymkhana venue set.
action_or_input: Submit a session or event using the configured venue.
expected_result: The venue selection is accepted.

purpose: Verify that an unconfigured venue is rejected for booking.
preconditions: The selected venue is not configured for Gymkhana booking.
action_or_input: Submit a session or event using the unconfigured venue.
expected_result: The booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify that the assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review reports for the assigned club.
preconditions: A club has submitted event reports and the authenticated faculty member is assigned as its Club Faculty Councillor.
action_or_input: Open or review a submitted report belonging to the assigned club.
expected_result: Report access and review are allowed.

purpose: Verify that a faculty member cannot access or review reports for another club.
preconditions: Submitted reports exist for a club to which the authenticated faculty member is not assigned.
action_or_input: Attempt to open or review a report for that other club.
expected_result: Report access and review are denied.
